public_rationale: Vance's February 11, 2025 speech criticized regulatory burdens and emphasized AI infrastructure expansion over safety concerns, supporting the deregulatory direction Marcus described [e1]. But Vance also promised workers a role in major federal AI policy decisions and policies aimed at higher wages, better benefits, and safer communities [e2]. The deregulation warning therefore has support, while the sweeping characterization that individuals would receive no protection is qualified by the speech's explicit worker commitments [e1, e2].
limitations: The speech establishes stated policy positions, not subsequent implementation or actual protection of workers [e1, e2].
It does not establish corporate control of government, AGI overhyping, or protest as citizens' only effective option [e1, e2].
